name: Monument 83 Lookout
summary: Log cabin fire lookout on the BC-US border in Manning Park, built 1930 and still standing; reached by a hiking trail of about 30 km round trip.
design: Crossed-log cabin with a small glass-walled observation room on top of the main roof
agency: BC Parks (Ministry of Environment), per the register's source credit

access.note: In Manning Provincial Park and reached by a hiking trail. A hiking guide describes the trail as damaged but does not describe it as closed.

visit.trail_note: Trailhead about 3.5 km east of Gibson Pass Road, off Highway 3. Round trip about 30 km. Backcountry fees apply to overnight stays.

events.note: Log cabin cupola constructed on the site; later surveys placed it on Canadian soil.
Canadian Register of Historic Places, entry 18048: recognized by the Province of British Columbia, date recognized December 31, 1941.
US-side 30 ft L-4 tower. The association's structure header gives 1952; its history text gives 1953.
